name: Marked-Edge Audit of the Certified 288- and 289-Concept Rooted Factors
definition: Enumerate every edge incident with the unique root corner in the certified factors $A_{288}$ and $B_{289}$. For each edge, test all 22 zero-restriction and contraction images in other coordinates for relative peeling to the edge image, and test the three section/contraction images in the edge coordinate for peeling to the projected endpoint.
parameters: The eligible directions are 1, 2, and 7 for $A_{288}$ and 1, 2, and 8 for $B_{289}$ in the certificate coordinates.
properties: All six incident root edges pass all 25 marked-edge tests with explicit replayed corner orders. This is a bounded input certificate and does not imply that every rooted factor satisfies the marked-edge hypotheses.
